title: Aale Nabi Pe Aada Yeh Zulm Dharahe Hai
body:
Aale Nabi Pe Aada Yeh Zulm Dharahe Hai
Sukhe Gaale Pe Sheh Ke Khanjar Chalarahe Hai
1.Padhte Hai Haq Ka Kalma Hai Naam Ke Musalman
Jo Run Me Shah-e-Deen Ke Dil Ku Dukharahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Akber Tadhap Rahe Hai Dil Par Seena Laagi Hai
Nazrou Me Hai Andhera Sheh Ladhkhada Rahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Karke Aadaye Shukar Mabood Run Me Sarwar
Peedhi Me Noujawan Ka Laasha Utharahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Soula Paher Ke Pyase Asghar Ku Karbala Me
Teer-e-Sitam Ka Zalim Paani Pilarahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Shabbir Dil Sambhale Aansu Baharehe Hai
Apne Pisar Ki Turbat Run Me Banarehe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Zalim Yeh Jante Hain Hai Tashnalab Sakina
Paani Dikha Dikha Kar Phir Bhi Baharahe Hai
